Title: Bayesian prediction of synthetic accessibility
Description: Judges how readily a compound could be made, using SYBA, a Bayesian scheme from Vorsilak and colleagues. Rather than fitting a model, it compares how often each molecular fragment appears among easy-to-synthesise compounds versus deliberately generated hard ones, and sums the resulting log-odds. The approach is transparent and fast, since the score decomposes into fragment contributions, but it reflects the fragment statistics of the reference sets rather than any explicit route search.
Interpretation: Synthetic accessibility score where higher values indicate an easier-to-synthesise compound.
